entities.name: Second Temple Judaism

entities.summary: The diverse religious landscape of Judaism during the Second Temple period (516 BCE – 70 CE), encompassing Pharisees, Sadducees, Essenes, and Zealots. Centered on Torah study, synagogue worship, Temple sacrifice, and anticipation of the Messiah.
